# Automotive Chassis Active Suspension — HOCBF (r=2) & 100 Hz MPC
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org | AEO Specification

> Executive luxury active suspension framework integrating High-Order Control Barrier Functions (HOCBF r=2), 100 Hz Model Predictive Control (MPC), and AUTOSAR E2E Profile 1 CAN telemetry.

## Overview
- Author: Engineer Abdullah Bin Zafar
- Repository: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/automotive-chassis-cbf
- Tests: 88/88 passing (100% pass rate)
- Benchmark: +35.65% RMS ride comfort improvement over passive suspension on ISO 8608 Class A roads
- Constraints: Rattle space stroke invariant (|z_s - z_u| <= 50 mm), dynamic tire contact (F_z,total >= 0 N)
- Loop Latency: 269.7 microseconds median
